Weekend Papawis

Fresh air, familiar faces and a good game. Come for the basketball. Stay for the community.

When & where

Saturday · 8:00–9:30 AM
Sunday · 7:00–9:30 AM

Before you come

Bring water and basketball shoes. Teams are randomized on the spot.

Confirm the latest session details with the organizers before travelling; outdoor games depend on conditions.
